name: ttd

download_files.format: TXT (custom key-value, entity-ID-prefixed, multi-value INDICATI rows)

license.stated_paper: CC BY-NC 4.0 (paper is an Open Access article under CC Attribution-NonCommercial License)
license.observed_site: Not independently re-stated on the JS-rendered homepage (SPA shell only); relying on the paper's stated license, which is standard for NAR Database Issue open-access articles

paper_vs_reality.observed: 4,298 targets in live v10.1.01 (2024.01.10/2024.03.30) download files
42,939 drugs in live P1-02 file (used by the sibling drug-centric ttd plugin, not re-verified in depth here since this evaluation focuses on the target file)
P1-06 contains free-text disease names with bracketed [ICD-11: <code>] annotations per indication row, consistent with ICD-11-based classification

paper_vs_reality.claim: Freely accessible without login (Data Availability statement)
paper_vs_reality.observed: Confirmed -- both files download via plain curl with no auth, cookies, or redirect wall

idrblab.org/ttd/ redirects to https://ttd.idrblab.cn/ (a Vue.js SPA); real download links resolve to https://ttd.idrblab.cn/files/download/<file> discovered via the SPA's bundled JS (Download-*.js chunk), not from a static HTML download page

risks: Homepage/download page is a JS-rendered SPA (Vue.js) -- no static HTML links; direct file URLs had to be extracted from the compiled JS bundle (assets/Download-*.js) rather than from page HTML. Confirmed real via curl content-type and content inspection (plain text with TTD header block), not guessed.

Live data (v10.1.01, dated 2024.01.10 header / 2024.03.30 for P1-06) is newer than the paper's reported snapshot -- record counts differ from the published paper (see paper_vs_reality). This is expected drift for a continuously updated database and not a data-quality concern.

Same 'ttd' output slug already used by a prior, unrelated plugin generation (drug-centric, DOI 10.1093/nar/gkaf1154) recorded in built-plugins-index.md at the same path -- see relevancy.json risks for details.
